name: Vegetable salad
summary: This salad gathers about 40 indigenous vegetables, leaves, sprigs, and roots on one plate. It sits beside grilled meat or a hot pot.
howToEat: Eat it with grilled meat or a hot pot, at lunch or dinner.
seoDescription: A Mang Den salad of about 40 indigenous vegetables, leaves, sprigs, and roots, eaten with grilled meat or hot pot.
